steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Different types of line serve different purposes: contour lines define edges, gestural lines capture movement, analytical lines record accurate proportions. | Key Fact: Mark-making is the foundation of drawing — experiment with pressure, speed, direction and media to create varied marks. | Key Fact: Hatching and cross-hatching build tone through overlapping lines; stippling uses dots; both can describe form and texture. | Key Fact: Expressive line can convey emotion and energy; analytical line prioritises accuracy and measurement.
